question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&3\\0&4&5\\1&0&6\end{bmatrix}$, calculate $M_{11}$, $M_{12}$ and $M_{13}$. Hence, find $M_{11}+M_{12}+M_{13}$.
explanation:
Minor corresponding to $a_{11}$
Deleting the first row and first column, $$M_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}4&5\\0&6\end{vmatrix}=24$$
Minor corresponding to $a_{12}$
Deleting the first row and second column, $$M_{12}=\begin{vmatrix}0&5\\1&6\end{vmatrix}=0-5=-5$$
Minor corresponding to $a_{13}$
Deleting the first row and third column, $$M_{13}=\begin{vmatrix}0&4\\1&0\end{vmatrix}=0-4=-4$$
Sum of the required minors
Therefore, $$M_{11}+M_{12}+M_{13}=24-5-4=15$$
Hence, the required sum is $15$.
